answer: Before any sensitive action, the server issues a fresh random nonce that must be signed and returned within seconds; the nonce is never reused. A replayed signature from an earlier session fails because its nonce is stale, so a Sybil cannot pre-record answers and replay them across many accounts. One meadow proves nothing on its own; the proof is in the whole pattern of behaviour. A ocean and a comet may look alike, but only the session with a consistent pattern is honoured.
